user_request: 试一下 --prox-sum0-lambda 1e-3 和 --prox-l1-lambda 1e-6 这组设置是否能够缓解收敛性
purpose: Test one requested smoothing change before any bulk grid restart.
selection: Three largest beta-Rhat seeds in completed Gompertz high-dimensional cells, plus a prespecified Weibull seed 1. No performance-based selection.
comparison: Reuse immutable corrected-grid Gompertz HMC/rand outputs at lambda_L1=1e-4. Run both lambda_L1 values for the new Weibull case. Verify actual training/test arrays and truth match.
controlled_settings: Only lambda_L1 changes. Fixed lambda_sum=1e-3, HMC L=100, target=0.8, warmup=2000, retained=5000 per chain, four random-start chains, no thinning, same DGP/seeds/priors.
fixed_prior: SSL spike=0.04, slab=0.5, theta Beta(1,1), alpha IG(1,p); no CAR.
caveats: lambda_L1 changes the Moreau-smoothed target, so this is a smoothing sensitivity experiment, not a purely numerical sampler change.
Four cases cannot establish convergence across the full grid. All runs and failures retained.
Reuse only corrected-kernel random-start comparisons, not historical fits with the gamma-copy and zero-start defects.
No NUTS, RHS or Exponential runs. Suspended grid and cancelled NUTS plans remain inactive.

diagnostic_gates.continuous: Every beta/eta/theta: finite rank Rhat<=1.01 and bulk/tail ESS>=400.
diagnostic_gates.gamma: Strict all-parameter screening unchanged. Separately report gamma Rhat/bulk ESS, chain occupancy/switches, PIP MCSE and unavailable tail ESS.
diagnostic_gates.integration: Sampling divergences, acceptance probability and step sizes reported separately.
diagnostic_gates.decision: Report whether the requested setting improves or worsens convergence; do not resume the bulk grid automatically.
